appearance_facts.fact: Blue bar for Surface water; top edge aligns with the 40 gridline, with the numeric label 41.2% centered above it.
Tall teal/mint bar for Groundwater; it is the visually tallest column, with its top edge just below the 70 gridline and the label 29.8% above it.
Blue-purple bar for Desalination; top edge sits between the 50 and 55 gridlines, with the label 18.5% above it.
Green bar for Recycled water; top edge is just above the 20 gridline, with the label 7.2% above it.
Brown bar for Rain capture; top edge is just above the 30 gridline, with the label 3.3% above it.
Bold black title 'Urban Water Supply by Source' spans the upper area above all bars.

public_definitions: Routing criterion: 'Largest urban water-supply contribution source' (visible_context_4).
User goal: 'identify the largest urban water-supply contribution source, then route that source record to escalated contribution review.'
Option labels: 'Route Surface water to escalated contribution review', 'Route Groundwater to escalated contribution review', 'Keep Desalination in routine source monitoring'.
uncertain: The numeric data labels (e.g., 41.2%, 29.8%) are inconsistent with the bar heights and the y-axis scale (e.g., the Groundwater bar is the tallest yet carries the second-highest label 29.8%, while the Surface water bar is shorter yet carries the highest label 41.2%); the basis for 'largest contribution' (label value vs. bar height) is not explicitly defined.
